text:
maya: Morning team — async checkin. Yesterday: finished Node SDK quickstart draft + example app. Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/432 with 3 doc pages. Blocker: sampleapp CI failing on ubuntu-latest (npm ci step).

sam: I saw that PR, nice work. I'll take a look at the CI tomorrow. error is 'ENOENT: no such file or directory' in postinstall script — maybe path issue.

alex: On docs review queue — leaving inline comments on API surface. @maya pls add a paragraph about streaming/resume semantics.

priya: Quick Q: sampleapp uses streaming via ws — should we prefer SSE for examples? I can prototype both if needed.

leo: I updated the quickstarts landing copy and a small CSS tweak. Preview: https://deploy-preview.devex/qs-1823

maya: Thanks @alex @sam. I'll add the streaming paragraph. @priya SSE would be simpler for plain HTML clients — let's default to SSE and add a 'WS advanced' appendix.

devex-bot: CI status: devex/sampleapp CI failed on branch maya/quickstart — 1/3 steps failed. See https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/12345

sam: Taking CI — pushing a quick fix for postinstall path in 30m. Proposed fix: 
```bash
sed -i 's#./scripts/postinstall#./scripts/postinstall.sh#' package.json
```
@maya can you rebase PR after?

maya: Yep will rebase once fix lands. Also note that the Node SDK sample uses ESM import style; added a note for CJS users.

priya: If anyone's doing sampleapp changes, ping me for a quick smoke — I have a fresh Ubuntu VM.

alex: I'll finish docs review by EOD. Also flagging a small copy tweak on the 'rate limits' section.

leo: :thumbsup: thanks all. Blockers today: none except review queue. Available for UX polish.

maya: OK moving to today: rebase + add streaming paragraph + fix README examples. Will ping when updated. Thanks!
